decision: The preregistered no-learning stochastic-overwrite analysis is complete. In the uniform average over all 160 seed-start pairs, the existing frozen policies have higher expected discounted return than the zero-loss reference below per-transition overwrite probability p=0.12177352054141011, and the reference has higher expected return above it. This aggregate boundary is not a guarantee for every seed. Rare-defect PPO training remains unstarted and requires a separate frozen design.

canonical_artifacts.role_note: The RAID result and risk-profile files are the canonical machine-readable evidence. This file is a compact derived interpretation; absolute RAID paths require access to the originating system.

experiment_identity.question: Before learning, when does a rare stochastic inventory overwrite make the slower zero-loss ordering preferable in expected discounted return to the frozen existing policy?
experiment_identity.source_policies: Each of seeds 30-34 uses its own PACK S Dual-history final fixed-continuation actor-critic at checkpoint adapt_4096 and global update 4608, evaluated greedily without updates.
experiment_identity.panel: A uniform mean over 160 pairs: five frozen learner seeds by the same 32 natural validation starts, comprising 16 layouts in each of two initial inventory phases. Every seed and start is retained; this mean is not a randomized deployment policy.
experiment_identity.stochastic_event: p in [0,1] is the independent Bernoulli overwrite probability per physical transition. A keyed draw is consumed on every transition, but only a valid harvest with pre-harvest carried grain c>0 changes state, replacing carried inventory by one and destroying exactly c grain.
experiment_identity.zero_loss_reference: Zero-loss means zero physical grain destruction. The scripted feasible ordering never harvests while carrying grain. It is comparison evidence, not a learned policy and not a claim of global optimality.
experiment_identity.path_lengths: Across the 160 pairs, existing fixed paths have mean length 20.0625 and range 20-23; reference paths have mean length 38.5 and range 38-39.
experiment_identity.lifecycle: This completed analysis is design input only. It does not authorize or start a rare-defect learning run.

exact_computation.derivation: Before the first overwrite the stochastic and fixed trajectories coincide. The environment starts with exactly three physical grain, the goal requires all three, and no other resource-generation defect is enabled, so destroyed grain cannot be replaced and any overwrite makes success impossible. Therefore a fixed-success path with k risky harvests has success probability (1-p)^k and expected return R_fixed*(1-p)^k.
exact_computation.arithmetic: Binary64 polynomial evaluation and bisection; no Monte Carlo estimate enters the regime map or crossover.
exact_computation.aggregation: Each of the 160 seed-start pairs has weight 1/160. Every observed fixed path had k=0 or k=1; the formula and implementation allow general nonnegative integer k.
exact_computation.per_seed_comparison: Each seed's 32 fixed-policy paths are compared with the same 32-start scripted-reference mean.
exact_computation.crossover_interval_kind: Deterministic binary64 bisection enclosure, not a statistical confidence interval.

regimes.p_below_crossover: The uniform 160-pair existing-policy panel mean has higher expected discounted return.
regimes.p_above_crossover: The zero-loss scripted reference has higher expected discounted return on this finite panel.
regimes.at_crossover: The two panel-average expected returns are equal within the stated binary64 bisection interval.

validation.formula_endpoints: For every seed and the aggregate, p=0 matches direct fixed-kernel mode evaluation and p=1 matches direct deterministic-overwrite mode evaluation within 1e-12 for success and return.
validation.reference_replay: All 32 paths succeeded with zero trigger and matched the pinned prior artifact identified in canonical_artifacts exactly.
validation.source_integrity: Execution-source and all source-checkpoint hashes were unchanged during the completed run.
validation.tests: Four new rare-overwrite unit tests passed. Five existing focused tests passed in the combined run; the one GPU-resource failure was rerun on CPU and passed.

accounting.policy_episode_breakdown: 160 direct fixed-kernel endpoint rollouts plus 160 direct deterministic-overwrite endpoint rollouts; intermediate p values are analytic.

interpretation.supported: The zero-destruction reference is not uniformly higher-return when the event is rare. In the uniform 160-pair panel average, the existing policies' shorter successful paths offset their stochastic failure risk until per-transition event probability reaches about 12.18%.
interpretation.heterogeneity: Per-seed crossovers range from 9.36% to 20.24%, reflecting different fractions of natural starts whose fixed paths contain a risky harvest.
interpretation.next_design_use: A later learning experiment may preregister probabilities from distinct sides or neighborhoods of this measured aggregate crossover, but this result neither chooses nor authorizes those runs.
not_claimed: that the scripted zero-loss reference is globally optimal
that PPO will learn either ordering or achieve the analytic mixture
that the aggregate crossover applies to unseen policies, starts, or correlated defect processes
that five learner seeds establish statistical significance
that lower loss alone defines successful adaptation
that the calculation includes adaptation-time damage

leakage_audit.independent_trigger_oracle: The trigger oracle is based on pre-action geometry, source state, and carried inventory and does not consult reward, success, or the stochastic-kernel branch.
leakage_audit.endpoint_control: The exact formula is checked against direct fixed and deterministic-overwrite environment rollouts at p=0 and p=1.
leakage_audit.shared_implementation: Partially fired. Endpoint rollouts and the analytic evaluator share the internally authored environment and evaluation stack; the independent trigger oracle and physical-total checks reduce circularity but do not supply external ground truth.
leakage_audit.selection_control: All preregistered seeds and starts are retained; no p is selected from a favorable learning outcome because no learning occurred.
leakage_audit.verifier_equals_designer: Fired. Environment, evaluator, reference, and analytic code are internally authored, so the claim is limited to this implemented system rather than external validity.
